title: SuDapp
tagline: Creating SuDapp - Hackathon Partner Finder   platform to meet and beyond hacker friends
description: Hackathon Partner Finder is a decentralized web platform designed to help users find the perfect hackathon partner based on shared interests, skills, and thought processes. By leveraging blockchain technology and smart algorithms, the platform ensures secure, transparent, and efficient matchmaking.
how_its_made:
The Hackathon Partner Finder is built using cutting-edge web3 technologies, ensuring a decentralized and secure platform for users. The frontend is developed with Next.js and styled with TailwindCSS, providing a modern, responsive user interface. For dynamic animations and interactions, the platform utilizes Framer Motion, while Radix UI components are employed for accessible and user-friendly interface elements.

The backend integrates with blockchain technology to offer trustless verification of user profiles and experiences, ensuring authenticity without the need for central authorities. A smart matching algorithm powered by AI helps users connect with potential partners who share similar skills and interests, enhancing collaboration.

The entire platform is structured to be scalable, secure, and user-centric, with features like decentralized workspaces, NFT badges, and transparent profiles making it a go-to solution for hackathon enthusiasts looking to find like-minded partners.
